commission.title: Commission
commission.subtitle: What each team member has earned from their clients.

rule.title: How commission is worked out
rule.body: Commission is worked out on each invoice line: price times quantity, minus that line's discount, before tax. It is earned only when the invoice is fully paid, never on a part payment. If a credit note is issued, the commission goes down in the same proportion. If a payment is refunded and the invoice is no longer fully paid, the commission is taken back until it is paid again. Earned commission is never edited or deleted: changes appear as new lines.

public.removedBody: Your sign-in account, name and email, your access and roles in every business, your notification settings and the devices registered for notifications.
public.keptBody: A business keeps its own records (appointments, invoices, payments, staff profiles) because the law requires it and they belong to the business. After deletion they no longer point to you.
public.ownerBody: If you are the only Owner, first delete the business or add another Owner. You will see which businesses in the same screen.
public.customerBody: Customers who booked with a business do not have a sign-in account. To see or erase your data, open the "My data" page from the link in your booking email, or ask the business.
public.contact: Cannot sign in? Write to {{email}} from the address on your account.

setup.title: Get ready for your first booking
setup.subtitle: A few quick steps and your customers can book you online.
setup.askOwner: Ask the owner of the business to do this step.
setup.solo: Working on your own? Add yourself as a staff member so customers can book you.

hours.title: Set your opening hours
hours.description: Customers can only book inside the hours your location is open.

service.title: Add your first service
service.description: Give it a name, a duration and a price.

staff.title: Add yourself or a team member as staff
staff.description: Bookings are made with a person, so someone must be on your staff list.

link_service.title: Choose who does the service
link_service.description: Open your service and tick the staff member who provides it.

staff_hours.title: Set their working hours
staff_hours.description: Each staff member needs the days and times they work.

enable_booking.title: Turn on online booking
enable_booking.description: Online booking is switched off for this location.

share.title: Copy your booking link
share.locked: Available once the steps above are done.

website.title: Publish your website
website.description: Optional: a simple page with your services and a Book button.

banner.title: Online booking is not available right now
